extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance plots found and digitised: Figure 3 and Figure 8. Figures 1, 2, and 4–7 are characterization/spectroscopy/microscopy and were skipped; Figure 9 is a schematic and was skipped. Values are approximate visual readings from the plotted markers/bars; where two STY bases were plotted for the same catalyst, separate records are provided because the schema has a single methanol_sty field.
